title: India’s cotton sowing trails last year, Gujarat boosts outlook
content:
India’s cotton sowing remains below last year’s level, with acreage at 7.51 lakh hectares versus 9.72 lakh hectares a year ago.
North India is expected to see lower cotton area as farmers shift to alternative crops.
However, strong planting growth in Gujarat, higher MSP and expectations of increased acreage in Central India are supporting optimism for the 2026-27 season.

title: Bangladesh–Türkiye textile talks: $876 mn trade corridor fuels FTA
content:
Bangladesh–Türkiye trade talks offer an opportunity to combine Bangladesh’s apparel scale with Türkiye’s strengths in fibre, yarn and finishing. 
While apparel dominates bilateral trade, resilient yarn exports highlight deeper supply-chain links. 
The success of any FTA/PTA will depend more on investment, sourcing flexibility and value-chain integration than tariff cuts alone.

title: Asian PTA prices rise as polyester demand boosts buying
content:
Asian PTA prices rose across China, South Korea, India and Southeast Asia, supported by stronger polyester demand and inventory replenishment. 
DTY filament yarn markets showed mixed trends, with export demand remaining firmer than domestic consumption. 
PTA gains outpaced DTY price increases, indicating margin pressure on yarn producers as feedstock costs continue to climb.

title: ICE cotton futures show mixed trend after hitting two-month lows
content:
ICE cotton futures remained under pressure as rising certified stocks and speculative liquidation weighed on sentiment.
July futures slipped to 73.30 cents/lb, while December posted slight gains.
Trading volume exceeded 106,000 contracts, reflecting heavy fund unwinding.
Improved US crop conditions and ample certified stocks kept the outlook bearish, especially for nearby contracts.

title: India launches portal to operationalise Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana
content:
Indian Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal yesterday launched a portal to operationalise the Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana (BHAVYA), which aims at developing 100 industrial parks to promote large-scale job creation through greater investments.
Through the portal, investors can access detailed information on industrial parks like land availability, connectivity and surrounding infrastructure.

title: Chinese, Cambodian customs ink AEO pact to streamline trade procedures
content:
The customs authorities of China and Cambodia recently signed an authorised economic operator agreement to facilitate trade by simplifying customs procedures, accelerate customs clearance for highly compliant businesses and reduce physical inspections of goods. 
Cambodia has 11 AEO companies and its government is working to raise that number to 30, by the end of this year.
